neighbours.label: the comma after a completed clause in a narrative, before it continues with another action (start with a Sharpie, but finish...; took a photo of my mug, then...), as opposed to list commas and commas after an opening word
fire: I usually begin with a pencil, but finish in ink.
He climbed onto the fence at the edge, and he waved.
So I took a picture of the sign, then threw it away.
They walked to the barn where he was sleeping, tired and cold.
She printed out copies of the map, then handed them around.
We went over to the old mill, and it was shut.
He grabbed his coat from the hook, but forgot his keys.
I put the kettle on the stove, then sat down.
quiet: She packed socks, shirts, belts, and hats.
Tom, Mary, Ann, and Bob went home.
Red, green, and blue are colors.

short: comma after a clause, before more action
notes: A list comma reached 0.19 in a probe. Russian and quote-closing commas on the card are not tested.
